name: Latitude
description: Traces, scores, and evaluates production AI agents via OpenTelemetry and SDKs, groups failures into signals, and dispatches coding agents over MCP to fix them.

skills.name: Trace Ingestion
skills.description: Captures multi-turn sessions, tool calls, and execution paths through TypeScript and Python SDKs or any OpenTelemetry exporter.

skills.name: Agent Score
skills.description: Computes a daily 0 to 100 project score across outcome, reliability, cost, speed, and safety from real production sessions.

skills.name: Automated Evaluations
skills.description: Scores sessions with condition sets, LLM judges, or custom JavaScript scripts, and replays regression datasets against fixed failures.

skills.name: Agent Dispatch
skills.description: Wakes a coding agent with sample traces when a signal needs follow-up, via MCP, Linear, or webhooks, so it can investigate and open a PR.
